item.title: High-Speed Train Collides With Another Train in Spain; 21 Dead, Many Injured
item.description: A major rail disaster struck southern Spain on Sunday night after a high-speed passenger train derailed and crashed into another train in Córdoba province, leaving at least 21 people dead and many others injured.
